release.title: SPOT global results
release.name: Spatio-temporal quantification of plastic pollution origins and transport (SPOT) model
release.component: Material flow analysis and emissions inventory
release.citation: Cottom, J. W., Cook, E. & Velis, C. A. (2026). SPOT model - MFA Version 1.4.1-G-0426. Zenodo.
release.methodology: Cottom, Cook & Velis (2024), with the published release's Lancet Countdown methodological updates.
release.scope: Municipal solid waste and macroplastic emissions. These results describe 2020 and include modelled open-burning atmospheric emissions and exposure estimates.
release.uncertainty: The 5th and 95th percentiles span a central 90% modelled interval. Mean and median are available separately.
release.license: CC BY 4.0, subject to source-specific notices for reused third-party material.
release.null_note: A missing coefficient is unavailable or undefined; it is not zero.
